svg.title: Predictive-processing framework and experimental workflow
svg.desc: Panel A links predictions and errors across brain-wide, local-circuit, and single-cell scales. Panel B follows animals from surgery through intrinsic-signal-imaging mapping and habituation to one of three recording modalities. Panel C shows habituation and recording-context order across modalities and cohorts. Panels D and E show the shared session architecture and the context, control, and system-identification stimuli.

svg.title: Predictive-context cohorts across recording modalities
svg.desc: Five dedicated cohort timelines show eight outlined habituation sessions followed by filled recording sessions. Neuropixels and mesoscope sampled motor- and sequence-habituated cohorts in opposite context orders; SLAP2 sampled the motor-habituated cohort only.

svg.title: Within-session controls enable cross-context comparisons
svg.desc: Panel A shows the common session timeline, with a control block repeated immediately after the context block and additional controls, receptive-field mapping, and a zebra movie. Panel B details the four context blocks and shared control and system-identification stimuli.
